products.title: Diamond Sacred Heart Lariat
products.body_html: Eternal and enduring. Pierced and wounded, the sacred heart beats on, undeterred by time or trial. A symbol of transcendence, our Sacred Heart Lariat is meticulously crafted from solid 14k gold and finished with white diamonds. It serves as a wearable reminder of devotion, protection, and the transformative power of dedication to another. Remove one sword and let it dangle from the heart to create an even more dramatic silhouette, or wear it shorter with all three swords bisecting the heart.

products.title: Anatomical Heart Signet Ring
products.body_html: There is no force greater than a heart laid bare. An eternal symbol of love free from artifice, borrowed from the Gothic writers of the Romantic era, the anatomical heart is equal parts science and mysticism. The meticulously detailed heart is engraved in deep black onyx. The words AMOR VINCIT — love conquers — encircle the perimeter. Wear it as a reminder of the power of authenticity.
